name: web-qa
description: Playwright E2E and visual QA for a web frontend, plus web checks for /verify, /security and /test.

facts.name: WEB_QA_URL
facts.meaning: Deployed URL the owner allows read-only QA against after deploy, or none. Setting it is the owner's yes for read-only checks there
facts.ask: After a deploy, may QA load the deployed web app read-only? If yes, give its URL; otherwise answer none.

facts.name: E2E_DIR
facts.meaning: Directory holding playwright.config.* and the E2E specs
facts.ask: Where do the Playwright config and E2E specs live? (the directory holding playwright.config.*)

facts.name: WEB_QA_BREAKPOINTS
facts.meaning: Viewport widths in px for /playwright-qa screenshots. Default 375, 768, 1440
facts.ask: Which viewport widths should visual QA screenshot? (default 375, 768, 1440)

owner_tasks.task: Create a web QA test user, and a lower-privilege one for guard checks, and name their login env vars in docs/agent/verify-map.md (Test accounts)
owner_tasks.why: /qa and /playwright-qa sign in as them; never a real person's account

owner_tasks.task: Add @playwright/test to the project and install a browser once per machine with npx playwright install chromium

env.name: WEB_QA_USER_EMAIL
env.purpose: Login of the web QA test user. Record the name in docs/agent/verify-map.md (Test accounts); the project may use its own name instead
env.how_to_get: Create a dedicated test user in the app; never a real person's account

env.name: WEB_QA_USER_PASSWORD
env.purpose: Password of that test user, read by specs through process.env and never printed
env.how_to_get: Set when creating the test user; keep it only in the local env / secret store

env.name: WEB_QA_LOW_PRIV_EMAIL
env.purpose: Login of a lower-privilege test user, for /security route-guard parity checks
env.how_to_get: Create a second test user with the lowest role the app has

env.name: WEB_QA_LOW_PRIV_PASSWORD
env.purpose: Password of the lower-privilege test user
env.how_to_get: Set when creating that user; keep it only in the local env / secret store
